  begin
    require Rails.root.join('custom/wijaya/batteries/wecom_channel/routes').to_s

  rescue StandardError, ScriptError => e
    Rails.logger.error("[Wijaya] wecom routes failed: #{e.class}")
  end

if defined?(Wijaya::Batteries::WecomChannel::MessageWindowExtension)
  Conversations::MessageWindowService.prepend(Wijaya::Batteries::WecomChannel::MessageWindowExtension)
end
# WIJAYA_CUSTOM_END wecom_channel

# WIJAYA_CUSTOM_START wecom_channel

  Api::V1::Accounts::InboxesController.prepend(Wijaya::Batteries::WecomChannel::InboxesControllerExtension)
end
# WIJAYA_CUSTOM_END wecom_channel

## WeCom Attributes (corp_id/open_kfid only; secret/token/encoding_aes_key are never exposed)
if resource.channel_type == 'Channel::Wecom'
  json.corp_id resource.channel.try(:corp_id)
  json.open_kfid resource.channel.try(:open_kfid)
end
